correctness.rationale: Every distinct output has either zero changed positions (identity), a unique unequal-symbol pair at separation<=3, or exactly four changed positions in one length-4 window of weight two. This gives B4=1+sum_{d=1}^3 #unequal pairs at distance d + #weight-two four-windows. Appending bit b adds r+1_{r=2} where r is number of opposite bits among final three, at most three. At n=4 exactly six weight-two words attain B4=6. For equality extensions, the mixed final-three symbols exclude r=3 and force the unique minority append, preserving all new four-windows balanced. This yields max 3n-6 and exactly six infinite periodic extremizers for all n>=4. Independent actual permutation enumeration of all binary words n=4..10 replicated max and six maximizers; induction covers unbounded n.
